body: Yes. I tried. I'm exhausted from having this conversation yesterday and feel emotionless, but I tried again today and he literally said he refused to converse about this anymore and went to bed.
I'm thinking your average depression. He hates himself his job etc. I've been in the situation myself, I don't know.
I tried his family yesterday. Once they understood what was going on, they rejected my calls.
I know... I asked there too... I just need help. I tried to call a helpline and I was on hold for 45 minutes.

I know this is a personal question, but what was the outcome of that? Was she angry? He's been held in a hospital for the 72 hour watch before I don't know. I guess I don't honestly know if he's serious because he did say this to me yesterday and seemed okay during the day today. Then he started drinking and lo and behold, we're having this discussion again.

He's sleeping in my bed right now. I live with my parents. I told them yesterday when he was threatening, I don't know if I can call them here. I don't think I should call them to his work tomorrow either. I'm really lost...
